metadata.question: Does the agricultural land around Peoria, Illinois show more brown fields in October 2022 compared to September 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about agricultural land around Peoria, Illinois showing more brown fields in October 2022 compared to September 2022. To answer this, I need to: 1. Strategy: Use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) to measure vegetation health/greenness. Lower NDVI = more brown fields. Compare mean NDVI between Sept 2022 and Oct 2022. 2. Data: Use Sentinel-2 for good temporal resolution and NDVI calculation (bands B4=red, B8=NIR). 3. Location: Create a buffer around Peoria, Illinois coordinates. 4. Processing: - Get images for Sept 1-30, 2022 and Oct 1-31, 2022 - Cloud mask using QA60 band - Calculate NDVI = (B8 - B4)/(B8 + B4) - Compute mean NDVI for each period - Compare: if Oct NDVI < Sept NDVI, then more brown fields (Answer A: Yes) 5. Data quality checks: - Check collection sizes - Check valid pixel counts after masking - Validate NDVI range (-1 to 1) Let me implement this step by step. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const peoria = ee.Geometry.Point([-89.5889, 40.6936]); // Peoria, IL coordinates const region = peoria.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around Peoria const sept2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-09-01', '2022-09-30'); const oct2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-10-01', '2022-10-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition function getSentinel2Collection(dateRange) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(dateRange) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); } const septCol = getSentinel2Collection(sept2022); const octCol = getSentinel2Collection(oct2022); const septSize = septCol.size().getInfo(); const octSize = octCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sept 2022 Images: ${septSize}`); console.log(`Oct 2022 Images: ${octSize}`); // Check for empty collections if (septSize === 0 || octSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Cloud mask and NDVI calculation function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Process collections const septProcessed = septCol.map(maskClouds).map(addNDVI).median(); const octProcessed = octCol.map(maskClouds).map(addNDVI).median(); // 4. Calculate statistics const septStats = septProcessed.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const octStats = octProcessed.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const septMean = septStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const septCount = septStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const octMean = octStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const octCount = octStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Sept NDVI: ${septMean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${septCount}`); console.log(`Oct NDVI: ${octMean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${octCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (septCount === 0 || octCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (septMean === null || octMean === null || isNaN(septMean) || isNaN(octMean) || septMean < -1 || septMean > 1 || octMean < -1 || octMean > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Lower NDVI = more brown fields if (octMean < septMean) { console.log("A"); // Yes, more brown in October } else { console.log("B"); // No, not more brown in October } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
